event.description: Retrain rank9 position factor with zero weight decay
event.proposal: family: training control; current retained incumbent is 2982 parameters at 99.9700%, a +0.97 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0009, extending the reversed-input ff24 candidate to 30000 steps produced 99.99%; same-family failed result: attempt-0023, full-digit-only training of the MQA ff16 candidate at 3520/0.03%; prior attempts in this family: 2. The immediately preceding rank9 position candidate was a valid near miss at 2933/97.30% after 30000 mixed-digit steps, while its train log ended without a qualifying checkpoint. Hypothesis: AdamW weight decay may suppress the compressed positional basis; keep the exact rank9 architecture and change only weight_decay from 0.1 to 0.0, retaining the same 30000-step cosine schedule. This is more informative than changing both learning rate and duration because it isolates regularization as the nearest training-control alternative; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2982 parameters.
